- Expanded documentation with practical usage examples and clearer "Can Do/Can't Do" sections.
- Added notice about real-time pricing and data privacy.

Fix proxy URL to correct deployment endpoint

Initial release of tongcheng-travel-assistant.

- Provides full-category travel searching: hotels, flights, trains, buses, attraction tickets, integrated transport, and vacation routes.
- Returns real-time prices, ratings, and booking links for hotels, flights, and attractions.
- Supports flexible search filters via extra parameters, such as region, star rating, direct flights, and trip type.
- No configuration required; booking finalized on Tongcheng app or website.
- Natural language date descriptions supported.
